Target company: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD). AMD designs computing and graphics processors, including Ryzen, EPYC and Radeon products, serving PC, data-center, gaming and embedded markets.

Focal announcement: AMD Reshapes Automotive Industry with Advanced AI Engines and Elevated In-Vehicle Experiences at CES 2024.

Decision cutoff: 2024-01-04T23:59:59-05:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: AMD Reshapes Automotive Industry with Advanced AI Engines and Elevated In-Vehicle Experiences at CES 2024. Published date: 2024-01-04. URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1175/amd-reshapes-automotive-industry-with-advanced-ai-engines-and-elevated-in-vehicle-experiences-at-ces-2024.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: — New Versal AI Edge XA adaptive SoCs and Ryzen Embedded V2000A Series processors underscore AMD leadership for powering next-generation automotive systems — SANTA CLARA, Calif., Jan. 04, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Today, AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) announced it will showcase automotive innovation at CES 2024 and expand its portfolio with the introduction of two new devices, the Versal™ AI Edge XA adaptive SoC and Ryzen™ Embedded V2000A Series processor. Working alongside a growing automotive partner ecosystem, AMD will demonstrate at CES 2024 the broad range of capabilities and applications for these new devices in automotive solutions available today and in the future. Versal AI Edge XA adaptive SoCs add an advanced AI Engine, enabling the devices to be further optimized for numerous next-generation advanced automotive systems and applications including: forward cameras, in-cabin monitoring, LiDAR, 4D radar, surround-view, automated parking and autonomous driving. “As we look ahead to 2024’s Consumer Electronics Show, we are excited to showcase our achievements working in collaboration with our ecosystem partners that will advance the future of the automotive industry.”
